semiconductor_relevance: High — PCB Piezotronics provides precision sensors critical for monitoring and controlling semiconductor manufacturing processes.
summary: PCB Piezotronics GmbH specializes in high-precision sensors that support semiconductor manufacturers, particularly in lithography systems. Their products ensure consistent and high-quality manufacturing by accurately monitoring key processes throughout production.

regional_presence.Germany: PCB Piezotronics GmbH operates as the German sales subsidiary of the US-based PCB Piezotronics Inc.
